description: Split user stories into smaller, independently deliverable slices using the SPIDR method (Spike, Path, Interface, Data, Rules). Use this skill whenever the user asks to split a story, break down work, slice a story, asks "can this be split", mentions "SPIDR", says "story splitting", or wants to decompose a large ticket into smaller pieces. Also trigger when a user presents a story that seems too large for a single sprint and asks for help sizing or scoping it.
